name: loop_zone_edit
description: LP-4d1: a graph.loop drawn as a zone on the root canvas, and its body edited inside it. From a Blank project, Add loop puts a loop in the root over a new, empty body; the Graph tab draws it as a frame (graph_zone#loop). With the zone picked, Add fullscreen pass lands in the body -- scope loop_body -- and the pass is drawn inside the frame, named graph_node#loop_body/render_fullscreen. The zone is picked again by its heading (its middle is the body now); dragging the pass inside the frame writes the definition's placement and not the root's; with the count set to 2 in the Loop fields, the engine expands the loop twice, and the zone's heading and the Frame Plan's group say so. Dragging the frame writes the root's placement and leaves the body's as it was. Undo takes the frame's move back and then the body node's, each in its own document.
